turns.q: Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
turns.replyTail:
13:19
DreamCloud Bot
•
AI Agent

For a beginner, it's important to have a suitable bed base. DreamCloud mattresses work well on most foundations, bed bases (including slatted or divan), or adjustable frames. If using a slatted base, ensure the gap between slats is no wider than 9cm and the slats are at least 5cm wide. We do not recommend using your DreamCloud on the floor.

Additionally, we strongly recommend always using a mattress protector to care for your mattress.
